title: 基于Fisher信息距离的神经网络架构最优剪枝
summary: 本文提出一种基于模型空间微分几何距离的参数剪枝新方法。将剪枝视为模型向参数为零的超曲面移动，用Fisher信息度量下的测地距离衡量真实性能变化，由此建立剪枝最优性层级，从传统幅度剪枝发展到更高效的新方案。在MNIST和CIFAR-10上对全连接网络和视觉Transformer验证，性能优于幅度剪枝和局部Fisher信息剪枝。
summary_en: This paper introduces a new parameter pruning scheme derived from the differential-geometric distance in model space. Pruning is viewed as displacing the model to the hypersurface where a parameter vanishes, with the geodesic distance under the Fisher information metric determining the true change in model performance. This yields a hierarchy of pruning optimality, evolving from traditional magnitude pruning to more sophisticated schemes. Demonstrated on fully-connected networks and vision transformers over MNIST and CIFAR-10, it outperforms magnitude and local Fisher information pruning.
